objective: Implement the user-approved official-prosody-first complete-condition subset; code and small verification only, not full launch or active queue switch.
modules: src/glare_prosody_subset.py: strict audit, source-grid dependency/raster, immutable chunk/pair caches, admission/summary
scripts/prepare_glare_prosody_subset.py: bounded deterministic plan, official analyzer adapter and retryable extraction, versioned exports/review
scripts/run_glare_prosody_subset_cache.py: guarded survivor-only native nonprosody execution with shared canonical cache
source: Frozen selected500h rows and jobs SHA; verify source_result once per source to obtain correct full speaker normalized WAV, never listener WAV. Original source-level LUFS processing is retained; official librosa resampling and whole-track RMS normalization are applied and recorded.
chunks: Global0-origin2.4s chunks; only chunks needed by chosen pairs. Deduplicate by verified speaker track identity. Full short source tail is explicitly uncovered, never padded or treated as NULL.
audit: Exact raw NULL and legal numeric lines accepted; malformed/refusal/out-of-range/overlap/truncation excluded. No format repair or semantic retry. Official model,prompt,max64,greedy,batch cap16 and native normalization unchanged. Audios API alias and raw/EOS instrumentation are disclosed adapters.
mapping: Clip canonical2-decimal chunk intervals to pair using decimal subtraction, convert local offsets without a second2-decimal normalization, native floor/ceil raster, chronological later-event overwrite at raster collisions. N=ceil(duration25-1e-7), reference retained.
isolation: Frozen old files untouched. Extraction contract excludes pilot membership so full/pilot chunk caches reuse. Source/row/protocol/output SHA receipts; accepted only all required chunks accepted. Pending is distinct from rejection. No final training admission.
retries: Only source execution/IO and generation execution failures retry; CUDA OOM reduces batch down to1 first. Preserve attempts. Terminal semantic failures cache and are not retried. Model/API/integrity contract violations abort rather than dropping an entire population.
manifests: Immutable versioned train/dev retain/reject/pending snapshots, real durations and subgroup counts; test forbidden. Existing nonprosody payloads verified/reused; obsolete whole-pair prosody cache is incompatible.
downstream: Explicit prepare/run entry, separate worker metadata, shared canonical cache paths and frozen group protocol, filter ordinals within original groups. Acquire original controller and GPU worker locks; refuse while full queue still running. No automatic switch or training.
verification: Unit cases for NULL vs error, token truncation including padded EOS, grid boundaries/fractional origins, identity/corruption/resume and split protection. CPU320-pair plan; bounded real GPU7 canary and no-generation resume if resources permit. No other tasks stopped.
